_note: P5 shrine decorations (lane S, xeen-s7-p5, D-56). Rows 4017-4022, sprites 27017-27022 (pending texture), bindings in worlds/xeen/models/indoor_decorations.yml. Hands, cake and bench: yaw_offset -90 deg so that an entity's facing is the direction the model's front looks (A5's convention: facing 270 = south). Cube and scepter: z_offset = the palm's height over the hand's own floor, placed at the hand's xy with facing 0.

rows.name: xeen_stonehand
comment: P5 shrine (lane S, xeen-s7-p5, D-56; level_generation/decorations/xeen_p5hands_claude, xeen_p5props_claude):
